requirements.description: Mobile (<768px) vault header, 1-tap ABRN Cream/Slate mode pill, Active Folder Hero Card (Compartir Carpeta, Pedir Archivos, Equipo), and Subfolder Quick-Share Strip match /abrn/previews/mobile.html above the fold with zero overflow.
MobileFolderSheet renders root folders and indented child subfolders with 1-tap Compartir and Drop/Pedir Drop actions plus a single-line sticky bottom dock in both ABRN Cream and ABRN Slate.

MobileFolderShareSheet unifies Enlace #key (real WebCrypto batch key wrapping, Live Glass Twin, Sovereign QR SVG, active link sync, WhatsApp/Copy/Native), Buzón Drop, and Equipo RSA with Zero Dead-End empty-folder handoff.
Mobile file cards display format badges (PDF, CFDI, XLSX, 4K, MP4) + 1-tap Share/Inspect buttons, opening the 5-Format MobileInspectorSheet with Sacred SHA-256 Receipt and sticky dock.
Desktop (>=768px / 1440x900) 3-pane resizable workspace, ABRN Cream/Slate mode bar, telemetry strip, and right VaultInspectorPane suffer zero layout or functional regressions.

findings.reproduction: Open /abrn/files at 390x844 prior to fold polish.
findings.expected: Single-row header, compact search/filter row, Active Folder Hero Card, and visible file cards above the fold matching /abrn/previews/mobile.html.
findings.actual: DashboardLayout header wrapped onto 2 rows and legacy desktop breadcrumb/sort toolbar stacked ~420px above the hero card.
findings.cause: flex-wrap on mobile header plus unhidden desktop breadcrumb/sort toolbar and multi-row filter pills on <768px.
findings.fix: Made mobile DashboardLayout header flex-nowrap, FileSearch filter pills single-row overflow-x-auto with hidden scrollbar, and desktop breadcrumb/sort bar hidden md:flex while keeping hidden file/camera/folder inputs mounted.

findings.reproduction: Inspect mobile-active-folder-hero and mobile-subfolder-strip at 390x844 prior to button geometry polish.
findings.expected: All 3 hero action buttons fit inside card borders and subfolder chips scroll without a browser scrollbar track.
findings.actual: Full-text Equipo button overflowed the right border on 390px and Chromium drew a horizontal scrollbar bar beneath subfolder chips.
findings.cause: Three full text labels exceeded 326px inner card width and overflow-x-auto lacked scrollbar suppression.
findings.fix: Styled Equipo as a 44x44px square icon button (aria-label='Equipo', matching Phone 1 of /abrn/previews/mobile.html) and added [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden to mobile-subfolder-strip.

findings.reproduction: Open MobileInspectorSheet CFDI tab in ABRN Cream mode and open MobileFolderSheet on a long subfolder name at 390x844.
findings.expected: Crisp light text inside dark XML code stage and single-line Nueva Carpeta button in explorer dock.
findings.actual: Light-mode CSS dimmed .text-slate-200 inside the dark XML <pre> block, and Nueva Carpeta wrapped onto 2 lines.
findings.cause: Global light-theme utility overrides and equal-flex width on Nueva Carpeta.
findings.fix: Applied explicit inline #e2e8f0/#161922 dark-stage colors in MobileInspectorSheet, shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap on Nueva Carpeta in MobileFolderSheet, and scrollIntoView on the Sovereign QR card.
